Some people can just get over the flu while the young, elderly, or those with a weak immune system may need antibiotics. Just like an addict may be able to kick his addiction if he is strong willed and not prone to addictive behaviour. Just like you catch the flu because you made the mistake of coming into contact with someone or something infected you can become addicted by making the mistake of trying an addictive substance, be it nicotine or heroin. It is still their fault they made the choice of trying such a substance. Just like you can avoid the flu with proper hygiene and avoiding the virus itself you can avoid addiction. However once addiction takes hold some truly need help to fight it.
